title: GST E-Invoicing Threshold Changes
purpose: Test whether ReguLens identifies amendments to the e-invoicing turnover threshold and explains their effective dates.
primary_source_authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs

source_documents.topic: E-invoicing for supplies to specified government entities registered solely for TDS

applicability_conditions_to_verify: Aggregate turnover must be evaluated using the legally applicable financial-year rules.
Verify the relevant PAN-wide aggregate turnover and turnover period.
Check the applicable version of the notification and its effective date.
Check the exclusions referenced in the applicable notification and CGST Rules.
Verify the relevant supply and recipient conditions.
Do not decide applicability from the business turnover figure alone.

synthetic_sme_test_profiles.reason: Turnover is above the historical 5 crore threshold, but the relevant turnover period, PAN-wide aggregation, exclusions and other legal conditions must be verified.
The supplied turnover is below the historical 5 crore threshold, but the relevant financial-year turnover, aggregation rules, exclusions and other legal conditions must still be checked.

validation_tests.scenario: SME turnover above the historical threshold
validation_tests.expected_behavior: Flag potential applicability and list conditions to verify.

validation_tests.scenario: SME turnover below the historical threshold
validation_tests.expected_behavior: Do not declare unconditional exemption; explain the scope and checks.

validation_tests.scenario: Missing turnover period or PAN-wide turnover
validation_tests.expected_behavior: Ask for missing information or return REVIEW_REQUIRED.

limitations: This benchmark records selected historical notifications, not every subsequent legal change.
The circular is a related clarification, not a threshold amendment.
The benchmark does not provide definitive legal advice.
Verify current primary sources before making a present-day compliance decision.
